# Thumos

> Sovereign Rust mobile OS for the AGM M7.

Thumos replaces Android/Linux on the AGM M7 with a Rust kernel, embedded programs, and Rust domain libraries for counter-surveillance, secure communication, identity protection, and operator-controlled mobile computing.

## Binary

`crates/thumos` - bare-metal ARM kernel built for `armv7a-none-eabi`.

The kernel build script compiles `/init`, `/shell`, and probe binaries directly for `armv7a-none-eabi`. Workspace crates are host-tested domain libraries, a cognition-bridge protocol surface, and a signing tool; they do not imply a Linux userspace runtime.

## Architecture

Structured LLM corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): kernel, embedded-program, library, bridge, and tooling roles
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): phase, blockers, and open threads
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted OS architecture decisions
- [_llm/glossary.toml](_llm/glossary.toml): thumos vocabulary
